title: HTTP Lifecycle Plan Reader and Validator
summary: The FP-MCP-257 read-only HTTP lifecycle plan reader and validator was implemented, exposed, and verified against the FP-MCP-256 plan artifact. The tool read planId HTTPPLAN-20260703T233517042Z-9242deff under FP-MCP-254, read the source request artifact REQ-20260703T231957999Z-32fcb25f, and validated that the plan is readable, schema-valid, identity-matched, source-request-matched, lifecycle-ready, and still not invoked. Result: validationRan=true, planReadable=true, sourceRequestReadable=true, planValid=true, planMatchesSourceRequest=true, artifactTypeValid=true, schemaVersionValid=true, packetIdMatches=true, planIdMatches=true, requestIdMatchesSource=true, requestArtifactPathMatchesSource=true, modelMatchesSource=true, runModeMatchesSource=true, requestStateAllowed=true, lifecyclePlanReady=true, executionAuthorized=false, approvalConsumed=false, runnerStartEndpointContacted=false, opencodeStarted=false, lifecycleInvoked=false.
caveats: The validator reads and validates an existing plan artifact only; it does not invoke the HTTP lifecycle.
The validator confirms source request consistency at read time but does not lock future repository state.
The plan remains bound by hashes, not raw prompt text.
boundaries: No runner start endpoint was contacted.
